pills.label: Underground Cave
pills.pop_html: A 3 km stretch of the caves under Castle Hill, reopened to the public in 2019.Geology plus 800 years of human use: storage, prisons, war refuges and even 90s parties.

pills.pop_html: 10–12 °C inside all year. Wear warm clothes and shoes you don't mind getting dirty.Look out for the spot where a mammoth left one of its teeth.

best_for.skip_html: if anyone in your group has limited mobility: the cave is not accessible.
